Lightless Errand.name: Lightless Errand
Lightless Errand.description: The shadow thins into a ribbon and slips under doors, through vents and along dark corners as far as a whole floor away while the user stays still. It sees in the dark, whispers back what it finds and can flip a latch or carry a phone to someone trapped; a light or a blow sends it snapping back to the user. Strain: moderate.
